methodological_rigor.justification: Preclinical in vitro organotypic raft culture model of HPV16-driven oral cancer. Appropriate controls (primary tonsil keratinocytes, HPV-free raft tissue). Viral titers quantified by qPCR. Immunofluorescence with defined antibody panels. Multiple passage measurements. Limitations: no randomization/blinding, single institution, limited in vivo validation, organotypic model does not fully recapitulate tumor microenvironment.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Preclinical model development study. Addresses relevant clinical problem (HPV+ OPSCC early detection) but provides no direct clinical evidence. Claimed value is for future biomarker discovery and early detection strategy development.

reporting_quality.justification: Methods adequately described. Some ARRIVE gaps: no explicit randomization/blinding statement, animal ethics mentioned but incomplete detail, no data availability statement. Immunohistochemistry protocols detailed but interpretability limited.

novelty_literature.justification: Organotypic raft culture systems established for HPV infection; this application to oral cancer progression is incremental. HPV16 E6/E7 effects on differentiation well-characterized.

writing_presentation.justification: Methods detailed. Results section dense with sequential passage data. Introduction well-motivated. Discussion articulates utility for biomarker discovery but speculative regarding specific biomarkers.

key_strengths: Establishes reproducible organotypic raft culture system mimicking HPV16-driven progression from precancerous to malignant states
Comprehensive molecular profiling across passages (keratin expression, p16, p53, Rb, metabolic markers) enabling characterization of transformation markers
key_concerns: Purely preclinical model lacking external validation or comparison with actual HPV+ OPSCC patient samples
Proposed biomarkers (p16, K8, p120, COX5B) not validated for early detection in clinical specimens
No blinding/randomization; limited statistical rigor; speculative mechanistic interpretations regarding disease progression
chief_reviewer.rationale: Preclinical model development without clinical validation or biomarker validation. Tier 4 appropriate for exploratory in vitro work.
